exposure: GDM with high fasting blood glucose
GDM with normal fasting blood glucose
cohort: 2388 pregnant women who received antenatal care at Health Centers and delivered at the Centro Hospitalar Conde de São Januário in Macau between June 2018 and December 2019
finding: Mild gestational hyperglycemia and GDM with high fasting blood glucose were associated with higher rates of adverse maternal outcomes, macrosomia, and large-for-gestational age infants.
mod_finding: Mild gestational hyperglycemia and gestational diabetes mellitus with high fasting blood glucose were associated with higher rates of assisted delivery and primary cesarean section.
